title: Step inside the 'other side' of Rochdale Town Hall with guided Court Chamber tours
excerpt: Visitors are being invited inside Rochdale Town Hall's lavishly decorated Historic Court Chamber as guided tours reveal one of the building's lesser-seen restored spaces.
body:
Visitors are being invited to take a look at the ‘other side’ of Rochdale Town Hall with guided tours of its beautifully restored Historic Court Chamber.

The lavishly decorated chamber is one of the Town Hall's lesser-seen spaces and has its own collection of stories from the building's long history.

Rochdale Town Hall is now offering dedicated Court Chamber Tours, giving residents and visitors the opportunity to experience the historic room up close and learn more about the role it has played over the years.

The tours are aimed at everyone from local-history enthusiasts and architecture lovers to people who have simply wondered what lies behind some of the Town Hall's less familiar doors.

The chamber forms part of the wider heritage of Rochdale Town Hall, which reopened following a major restoration project designed to conserve the Grade I-listed building and reveal more of its historic interiors to the public.

Organisers describe the Court Chamber as a hidden gem and say the guided experience will uncover stories connected with one of the Town Hall's most extraordinary spaces.

Places on the tours are limited and visitors are being encouraged to book in advance.

Bookings and further information are available through Rochdale Town Hall at https://buff.ly/7ov1mDG.
